---
title: "Software"
---

Ready-to-use implementations of the methods from my papers, so you can apply them to
your own data. These are method packages, not replication files. If you use one,
please cite the corresponding paper (each repository has a "How to cite" section).

### bubble-test-tv-volatility

MATLAB implementation of the wild-bootstrap sup-DF / sup-BZ / union test for explosive
bubbles that remains valid under time-varying volatility.

- Repository: [github.com/yang-zu/bubble-test-tv-volatility](https://github.com/yang-zu/bubble-test-tv-volatility)
- Paper: Harvey, Leybourne and Zu (2019), *Econometric Reviews* — see [Research](research.qmd)
